summary: Diff updates HDDHub arm rotation mapping to a constrained 0°–30° range across 13 lanes, enforces a square (1:1) platter container with centered transform origin for rotation, and introduces computed glow-ring geometry centered on a defined platter center with radius derived from arm-tip distance (with a clamp). One potential spec gap is that clamping the glow ring radius can prevent true tangency/contact with the arm tip for some positions, which conflicts with REQ-42’s continuous tangency requirement.

missing_requirements.requirement: Glow ring remains tangent/in contact with the arm tip throughout the full arm movement range and during lane transitions, without appearing to move independently of the arm tip.
missing_requirements.reason: The glow ring radius is computed from the arm tip distance but then clamped (Math.min(..., 35)). If the true arm-tip distance exceeds 35%, the rendered ring will no longer reach the arm tip, breaking continuous tangency/contact for those lanes/positions.

hallucinated_features.description: Force pixelated/crisp image rendering on HDD body and disk via `imageRendering: 'crisp-edges'`.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any requirement; the BuildRequest focuses on arm rotation limits, square platter aspect/centered rotation, and glow ring centering/tangency.
